WITH reason_filter AS (
    SELECT 1 AS r_reason_sk
),
ss_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5'
        END AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS count,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(bucket1, 0) AS bucket1,
    COALESCE(bucket2, 0) AS bucket2,
    COALESCE(bucket3, 0) AS bucket3,
    COALESCE(bucket4, 0) AS bucket4,
    COALESCE(bucket5, 0) AS bucket5
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN count > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket1,
        NULL AS bucket2,
        NULL AS bucket3,
        NULL AS bucket4,
        NULL AS bucket5
    FROM ss_aggregates WHERE bucket = 'bucket1'
) t1
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN count > 39161 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket2,
        NULL AS bucket1,
        NULL AS bucket3,
        NULL AS bucket4,
        NULL AS bucket5
    FROM ss_aggregates WHERE bucket = 'bucket2'
) t2
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN count > 29434 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket3,
        NULL AS bucket1,
        NULL AS bucket2,
        NULL AS bucket4,
        NULL AS bucket5
    FROM ss_aggregates WHERE bucket = 'bucket3'
) t3
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN count > 6568 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket4,
        NULL AS bucket1,
        NULL AS bucket2,
        NULL AS bucket3,
        NULL AS bucket5
    FROM ss_aggregates WHERE bucket = 'bucket4'
) t4
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN count > 21216 THEN avg_ext_tax ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax END AS bucket5,
        NULL AS bucket1,
        NULL AS bucket2,
        NULL AS bucket3,
        NULL AS bucket4
    FROM ss_aggregates WHERE bucket = 'bucket5'
) t5
